text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Suzuka?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... J-just a dream...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's not much time until the
Takarazuka Kinen, so we're hard at
work,
training for the big day.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Squee! She's so fast, right from the start! I never get tired of watching Suzuka run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A style all her own, but one admired by
racers everywhere! I get
goosebumps just
standing here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her sudden sprint right out the gate is a
key part of Silence Suzuka's
trademark
style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's making a mad dash for
the finish line, yet she's
nowhere near it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Normal racers would slow down to
conserve their stamina by now, but
not
her! She's just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if impelled by those words, Silence
Suzuka's cleats kick harder
against the
ground, sending her flying down the
course even faster.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wooow! Her speed just shot up again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching her run is like being in a dream.
Fans and racers alike can't contain their
excitement—and to be honest, I can't
quite hold it back
myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With every lap, she gets better—faster. At
this rate there's no telling
how far she'll—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You and Suzuka seek to boldly go where
no racer has gone before. The ideal you
search for may even lie beyond an
Umamusume's
capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But when you cross that threshold, her
legs...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Suzuka?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-is something wrong, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: N-no, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: N-no, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Suzuka! That's another
record!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I had a feeling I was going faster.
Everything just felt right.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, you're a shoo-in for the
Takarazuka Kinen! Don't you
think,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: ...Y-yeah, for sure.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: ...Y-yeah, for sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since my talk with Agnes Tachyon, I've
been on a constant quest for
resources on
racing injuries.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is there any way to predict an incident?
And if something happens,
what sort of
future can Suzuka expect?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I had hoped research would alleviate my
worries, but the more I read,
the more
anxious I grow...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(This racer absolutely destroyed the
competition in her debut race.
But her
second race...)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(She started out great—amazing even.
Everything was going smoothly
as she
entered the homestretch...)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(That's when she suddenly collapsed and
had to withdraw. Medical exams revealed
her legs had fractured from the strain of
her running...
She had to retire.)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(This runner was in the middle of a
race on a winning streak in her
senior year. She
sped up early on the final corner, hoping
to overtake the others from the outside.)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(But she suddenly slowed down... She
couldn't even cross the finish
line.)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(She had to pull out of racing... And she
never returned.)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(No matter where I look, stories of hopes
and dreams being dashed in
an instant
keep popping up.)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(To think Umamusume are walking such a
fine line...)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(To think Umamusume are walking such a
fine line...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She should be finishing up dinner by now,
yet she's standing in front
of me in her
tracksuit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She must plan on doing some solo training.
Again, she shows how
devoted she is to
going faster and farther than any racer
before her.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer, maybe it's just me, but you
seem to be staying late a lot
lately...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Is there...
something wrong with my current
skill set? Are you...
worried I won't win the
Takarazuka as I am now?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: (Not at all... In fact, there isn't a race you can't win as you are now.)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: (Not at all... In fact, there isn't a race you can't win as you are now.)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: (The way you run, the power you possess—it's almost overwhelming. Too overwhelming...)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: (The way you run, the power you possess—it's almost overwhelming. Too overwhelming...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her brow furrows as she awaits my answer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's gone through so much to achieve her
dream. She even switched
teams...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Do I have any right to stop her? To ruin
her dreams? Doubt clouds my
mind as I try
in vain to find the answer.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Um...
I'm not staying late for any particular
reason... More importantly,
how are you
feeling? Any issues with your legs?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Um...
I'm not staying late for any particular
reason... More importantly,
how are you
feeling? Any issues with your legs?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Are you, by chance, worried I'm overdoing
it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Then I assure you,
I'm fine. Seeing as it's
just before a race, I'm being
even more
cautious than usual.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
What's more, I feel the best I ever have.
There's not a single worry in
my head.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: After all, I have—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She stops, and her gentle expression
genuinely appears free of doubt
or worry.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Anyway... I'm going to go for a run.
Please
don't stay too late.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
I can't wait to see what sort of
scenery we find at the
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, we've been chasing after the
scenery she seeks
together...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What sort of view will she show me at the
Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What sort of view will she show me at the
Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Will it be a view of her crossing the
finish
line in record time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps I'll see her as the epitome of
strength, besting racers with
double her
experience...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Still in the lead is Silence Suzuka! She's
nearing the large zelkova tree
marking the
third corner!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(Stop that! Nothing like that is going to
happen!)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(I need to do more research. If I can just
find some common thread, I
can use that
to stop—)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, something feels wrong. I should
be looking at the
documents in front of
me, but...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Everything's... going black...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Everything's... going black...
